{{Top|leg}}
A '''container ring''' was a mechanical ringed device used for transporting [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo containers]] over short distances, typically among [[Space station/Legends|space stations]]. Anything passing through the ring, when activated, would be propelled forward at a considerable rate.

==History==
While growing up on [[Pellezara station]], the young [[Tarrin Datch/Legends|Tarrin Datch]] would hone his [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] skills by performing complex maneuvers through container rings and repair grids.
